title: Crowded Kitchen's Apple Hand Pies
ingredients: Filling: 3 peeled diced apples, 50g brown sugar, 1 tsp lemon juice
Filling: 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp cornstarch
Egg wash: 1 large beaten egg, 1 tbsp water
2 tbsp coarse turbinado sugar for topping
steps: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat, add diced apples, brown sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice.
Simmer apples for 8 minutes until softened, stir in cornstarch slurry, and cook until thick before cooling completely.
Roll out pie crust sheets on a floured surface and cut into uniform rectangular or circular base and top pieces.
Place cooled apple filling onto half of the dough pieces, top with lattice crusts or vented tops, and crimp edges sealed.
Brush the assembled hand pies with egg wash, sprinkle with turbinado sugar, and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
